translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Yihudaa Zeretsaa Gakkeedda Biittaa
Yihudaa zaretoo unttunttu yaran yaran shaakkina gakkeedda gadii biide Eedooma gadiyaan zawatiide, gedissa bagga gas'an de'iyaa S'iina giyaa bazzuwaa wurssetsaa gakkee.
Gedissa baggana unttunttu zaway Mas'ine Abbaappe gedissa bagga wurssetsaappe doommiide,
Akirabiima Pinuwaa aad'd'iidde, S'ina Bazzuwaana biide, K'aadeesa-Barnne gedissa gakkee. K'ay hewaappe shaakki biide, Hes'iroonaana aad'd'iidde, pude Adaara gakkiide, K'ark'k'akko simmee.
Hewaappe k'ay As'imoona aad'd'iidde, Gibs'e Shaafaan gaketti biide, Meeditiraane Abban zawatee. Gedissa baggana de'iyaa Yihudaa zaway hawaa.
Away doliyaa bagga zaway Mas'ine Abbaa gidiide, Yorddaanoosa Shaafay an geliyaa sa'aa gakkee. Huup'issa zaway k'ay Yorddaanoosa Shaafaa Mas'ine Abban geliyaa saappe doommiide,
pude Beeti-Hoogila kesiide, Beeti-Arabiyaa Zanggaaraappe huup'issana aad'd'iidde, Roobeela na'aa Bohaana shuchchaan zawatee.

Yaatiide zaway Ahuure (metuwaa) Wombbaappe Dabiira katamaa pude kesiide, wombbaappe gedissa baggana de'iyaa Adumiima Pinuwaa sintsa bazzuwaan de'iyaa Gelggalakko huup'iyaw mirk'k'ettee. Hewaappe k'ay Enishemeesha giyaa pulttiyaa aad'd'iidde, Eniroogeela giyaa saan zawatee.

Hewaappe Hinooma Zanggaaraa aad'd'iidde, Yaabuusawaanatuwaa katamay Yerusaalame de'iyaa deriyaappe gedissa baggana aad'd'iidde, deriyaa huup'iyaa kesseedda; he derii Hinnooma Zanggaaraappe away wulliyaa baggananne Rafayma Wombbaappe huup'issa baggana de'ee.

He deriyaa huup'iyaappe sintsaw biide, Nefttooha haatsaa pulttiyaa aad'd'iidde, Efiroona Deriyan de'iyaa katamatuwaakko kesseedda. Hewaappe k'ay duge Baa'aalaa woy K'iriyaati-Yi'aariima geetettiyaa katamaakko simmee;

Baa'aalappe k'ay away wulliyaa baggana de'iyaa Se'iira Deriyaakko mirk'k'ettee. Hewaappe k'ay huup'issa bagga Yi'aariima woy Kisaloona geetettiyaa deriyaa gakkiide, aappe duge Beeti-Shemesha wod'd'iide, Timina aad'd'iidde bee.

He zaway Ek'iroona huup'issa baggana de'iyaa pudetsan zawatiide, Shikaroonakko mirk'k'ettee; hewaappe Ba'aala Deriyaana aad'd'iidde, Yaabini'eelan zawatee. He huup'issa bagga zaway Meeditiraane Abban zawatee.
Away wulliyaa baggana de'iyaa zaway Meeditiraaniyaa Abbaw gas'an zawatee. Yihudaa zaratuu barenttu yaran yaran akkiide de'eeddawe ha zawatuu zaarina de'iyaa sa'atuwaanna.
Kaaleebi Kebroonanne Dabiira S'ooniide Oyk'k'eedda
Med'ina Goday Aa azazeeddawaadan, Iyyaasu Yifune na'aa Kaaleeba gakkiyaa gishuwaa Yihudaa gadiyaappe K'iriyaati-Arbbaa'a geetettiyaa Kebroona immeedda. Arbbaa'i Anaak'e aawuwaa.
Kaaleebi Anaak'e zeretsaa, Sheshaaya, Ahimaananne Talmmaaya geetettiyaa heezzu yaratuwaa Kebroonappe keseedda.
Hewaappe denddiide, Dabiira giyaa kataman de'iyaa asaa olanaw beedda; Dabiira katamay kase K'iriyaati-Sefera geetettee.
Kaaleebi, «K'iriyaati-Sefera olettiide oyk'k'iyaa uraw taani ta naatto Aakiso immana» yaageedda.
Kaaleeba ishaa K'anaaza na'ay Otini'eeli he katamaa olettiide oyk'k'ina Kaaleebi bare naatto Aakiso aw immeedda.
Aakisa Otini'eela geliyaa wode, Izi aabbu iziw gadiyaa immanaadan woosana mala Otini'eeli izo zoreedda. Iza bak'uluwaappe wod'd'aaddu; Kaaleebi izo, «Ayaa koyay?» yaagiide oochcheedda.
Iza, «Taw woytuwaa imma. Neeni kase taw Negeeben immeedda biittay gideedda diraw, haatsaa pulttotuwaa taw immaarikkii» yaagaaddu. Kaaleebi iziw killi pulttuwaakka hirkki pulttuwaakka immeedda.
Yihudaa Katamatuwaa
Yihudaa zaratuu barenttu yaran yaran laatteedda laatatuu hawaappe kaalliide s'aafetteeddawantta.
Gedissa bagga gas'an Eedooma zawaa matan de'iyaa Yihudaa asaa katamatuu K'abs's'i'eela, Edeera, Yaagura,
K'iina, Dimoona, Adi'aada,
K'edeesha, Has'oora, Yitinaana,
Ziifa, S'elema, Ba'aaloota,
Has'oori-Hadaata, K'iriyooti-Hes'iroona woy Has'oora,
Amaama, Shamaa'a, Molaada,
Has'aari-Gaadda, Heshimoona, Beeti-P'alees'a,
Has'aari-Shu'aala, Berssaabeeha, Biiziyootiyaa,
Baa'aalaa, Iyuuma, Es'eema,
Elttolaada, Kasiila, Horima,
S'ik'ilaaga, Madimaana, Sanssaana,
Lebaawoota, Shilihiima, Ayinanne Rimoona. Ha katamatuu barenttu mootsatuwaanna ittippe laatamanne udduppuna.
Gad'an de'iyaa katamatuu Eshttaa'oola, S'or"a, Ashiina,
Zaanoha, Engganiima, Taappuha, Enaama,
Yarmmuuta, Adulaama, Sookko, Azeek'a,
Shaa'irayma, Aditaymma, Gadeeranne Gaderootaymma. Ha katamatuu barenttu mootsatuwaanna ittippe tammanne oydda.
K'ay Yihudaa katamatuu S'inaana, Hadaasha, Migidaala-Gaada,
Diili'aana, Misip'p'a, Yok'iti'eela,
Laakisha, Bos'ik'aata, Egiloona,
Kaboona, Laahimaasa, Kitiliisha,
Gaderoota, Beeti-Daagoona, Naa'imaananne Mak'k'eedda. Ha katamatuu barenttu mootsatuwaanna ittippe tammanne usuppuna.
K'aykka Liibina, Eteera, Ashaana,
Yifittaaha, Ashiina, Nas'iiba,
K'a'iila, Akiziibanne Mareesha. Ha katamatuu barenttu mootsatuwaanna ittippe udduppuna.
Hewaadankka, k'ay Ek'iroona katamaa bare heeraan de'iyaa k'eeri katamatuwaanne mootsatuwaa ubbaa.
Ashddooda ellekka Ek'iroonappe biide, Meeditiraaniyaa Abbaa gakkanaw de'iyaa katamatuwaanne unttunttu mootsatuwaa ubbaa.
K'ay Ashddooda katamaanne Aa mootsatuwaa, Gaaza katamaanne Aa mootsatuwaa, biide Gibs'e Shaafaanne Meeditiraaniyaa Abbaa lank'k'iyaa gakkanaw de'iyaa sa'aa.
Gezziyaan de'iyaa katamatuukka Shamiira, Yatira, Sookko,
Daana, K'iriyaati-Saanaa woy Dabiira,
Anaaba, Eshttamoo'a, Aniima,
Goshena, Holoonanne Giilo. Ha katamatuu barenttu mootsatuwaanna ittippe tammanne itta.
K'ay Araba katamaa, Duuma, Esh"aana,
Yaaniima, Beeti-Taappuha, Afeek'a,
Humis'a, Kebroona woy K'iriyaati-Arbbaa'anne S'i'oora. Ha katamatuu barenttu mootsatuwaanna ittippe udduppuna.
K'aykka Maa'oona, K'armmeloosa, Ziifa, Yuus'a,
Iziraa'eela, Yok'idi'aama, Zaanoha,
K'aynna, Gib"anne Timina. Ha katamatuu barenttu mootsatuwaanna ittippe tamma.
K'ay Halihuula, Beetis'uura, Gadoora,
Ma'iraata, Beeti-Anootanne Elttik'oona. Ha katamatuu barenttu mootsatuwaanna ittippe usuppuna.
Hewaadankka k'ay K'iriyaati-Ba'aala woy K'iriyaati-Yi'aariimanne Raaba. Ha katamatuu barenttu mootsatuwaanna ittippe laa"a.
Woran k'ay Beeti-Aaraba, Middiina, Sekaaka,
Nibishaana, Mas'ine katamaanne Enggaada. Ha katamatuu barenttu mootsatuwaanna ittippe usuppuna.
Gidooppenne, Yihudaa Asay Yerusaalamen de'iyaa Yaabuusatuwaa kessanaw danddayibeykkino. Hewaa diraw Yaabuusawaanatuu hachche gakkanaassikka Yihudaa asaana ittippe Yerusaalamen de'iino.
